- $c_{2j} \geq c_{2j-1}+2$ (room for the free term between them)
- $c_{2j+1} \geq c_{2j}+1$ (consecutive positions, no free term)

The free term at position $3k-1$ sits between $c_{2k-1}$ and $c_{2k}$. Position mapping: $c_{2j-1}$ is at position $3j-2$, $c_{2j}$ at position $3j$.

## Greedy Minimization

$$c_1=8,\; c_2=18,\; c_3=24,\; c_4=27,\; c_5=32,\; c_6=36,\; c_7=40,\; c_8=45,\; c_9=48,\; c_{10}=54,\; c_{11}=56,\; c_{12}=63,\; c_{13}=64$$

**Optimality proof:** By induction, $c'_m \geq c_m$ for any valid sequence. Since $c'_1 \geq 8 = c_1$, and if $c'_{m-1} \geq c_{m-1}$, then $c'_m \geq c'_{m-1}+\text{gap} \geq c_{m-1}+\text{gap}$, and $c_m$ is the smallest value satisfying this. So greedy minimizes every $c_m$.

## Periodicity (mod 72)

$$64, 0, 8, 18, 24, 27, 32, 36, 40, 45, 48, 54, 56, 63, \underbrace{64, 0, 8, \ldots}_{\text{repeats}}$$

Solve $64 + 72q \leq 2024$: $q \leq 27.22$, so $q=27$.

$$c_{391} = 64 + 72 \times 27 = 2008 \quad (391 = 13 + 14\times 27)$$

- $a_{586} = 2008$, $a_{587}$ (free, $\in \{2009,\ldots,2015\}$), $a_{588} = 2016$
- $a_{589} = 2024$, $a_{590}$ (free, must be $> 2024$), $a_{591} = 2034$

So $a_{589} = 2024 \leq 2024$ and $a_{590} \geq 2025 > 2024$, giving $i = 590$.
